description: IntMap — Codex lifecycle hooks. Mirrors the SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json so a session starts knowing the same things in both products: branch, uncommitted changes, the free round number, last night's deep-tier verdict — and (#R696) the accumulated memory, which Claude Code loads on its own and Codex otherwise never sees. ⚠ Codex records hook trust against the hook's HASH — a new or edited hook is listed but SKIPPED until it is trusted once with /hooks (docs/AGENT-SETUP.md §7).
